# Vroom.pt - Motorsport Hub Portugal

> Vroom.pt is the ultimate digital platform for Portuguese motorsport, connecting fans, drivers, and organizers with real-time events, news, rankings, and event discovery.

## Key Sections & Features
- Event Discovery: Find ralis, hillclimbs (rampas), track days, karting, and off-road events across Portugal.
- Live Telemetry & Timing Integration: Real-time event updates and official community alerts.
- Driver & Team Ecosystem: Profiles, vehicle showcases, and management tools.
- Organizer Portal: Tools to publish and manage motorsport events seamlessly.

## URLs
- Homepage: https://vroom.pt/
